item.title: Emerald is the green mineral variety of beryl
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: The boundary between emerald and lighter green beryl depends on actual hue and saturation, not just seller terminology.
EXIMUTC view: Seek laboratory identification when a green beryl is sold as emerald.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/emerald-description
